document.about: Acta Crystallographica Section E (2008) structure report, PMC2961758. Its first page sets the title, authors and abstract in the left column and the `Experimental` section's crystal data, key against value, in the right. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#358): the crystal data were read in one table with the title's lines beside them, the title cut a line to a row. A reading across the page's gutter, between two columns of text, is now read again in each column.

checks.issue: #358: the title's lines were cells of a table across the gutter.
